## Profiles

| Profile | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [CQLCapabilityStatement](https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/cql/STU2/StructureDefinition-cql-capabilitystatement.html) | A system capability statement that can express which version of Clinical Quality Language (CQL) is supported. |
| [CQLEvaluationResult](https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/cql/STU2/StructureDefinition-cql-evaluationresult.html) | A parameters profile that supports the result of evaluating logic. |
| [CQLImplementationGuide](https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/cql/STU2/StructureDefinition-cql-implementationguide.html) | An ImplementationGuide profile that supports specifying ModelInfo configuration for the profiles in the implementation guide. |
| [CQLLibrary](https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/cql/STU2/StructureDefinition-cql-library.html) | A library profile that supports representing a CQL Library as a Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) Library resource. |
| [CQLModelInfo](https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/cql/STU2/StructureDefinition-cql-modelinfo.html) | A library profile that supports representing CQL ModelInfo as a FHIR Library resource. |
| [CQLModelInfoSettings](https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/cql/STU2/StructureDefinition-cql-modelinfosettings.html) | A Parameters profile that supports representing CQL ModelInfo settings. |
| [CQLModule](https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/cql/STU2/StructureDefinition-cql-module.html) | A library profile that supports representing the structural information of a logic library. |
| [CQLOptions](https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/cql/STU2/StructureDefinition-cql-options.html) | A Parameters profile that supports representing CQL translation options. |
| [CQLStructureDefinition](https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/cql/STU2/StructureDefinition-cql-structuredefinition.html) | A StructureDefinition profile that supports specifying ModelInfo configuration for the profile. |
| [ELMJSONLibrary](https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/cql/STU2/StructureDefinition-elm-json-library.html) | A library profile that supports representing a compiled CQL Library (ELM (in JSON)) as a FHIR Library resource. |
| [ELMXMLLibrary](https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/cql/STU2/StructureDefinition-elm-xml-library.html) | A library profile that supports representing a compiled CQL Library (ELM (in XML)) as a FHIR Library resource. |
